title: Chrome slot free for 16 min while 1 job waits

messages.text:
The Chrome slot (chrome-measure) has had no holder for 16 min (since 05:26Z; released by (shared) (last reader "ts-i273-release-chat" left)). The limit is 10 min.
Waiting on the status board: i268-release-init (owner ts-i268-release-init; waits on the Chrome slot).
What unblocks it: the next of ts-i268-release-init takes it (its queued hold, or node tools/lock.mjs run chrome-measure ...).
No steward on duty (mgmt-devices is parked): the lead handles this thread (I-175).
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the slot is taken (tools/idle.mjs, I-105).
